item.description:

item.title: Generating All 32-Bit Primes (Part I)
item.description:
📝 All prime numbers greater than will be congruent modulo to one of the numbers still remaining in the sequence. Clearly, no primes greater than 5 will be found in the darkened spokes. The time complexity of this algorithm is no different from that of the ordinary sequential trial division algorithm, since numbers are found on the coprime spokes.
🔗 Read more: https://hnlyman.github.io/pages/prime32_I.html

item.title: Show HN: Signet – Autonomous wildfire tracking from satellite and weather data
item.description:
📝 Signet turns satellite detections, thermal imagery, and weather data into autonomous wildfire tracking across the continental US. Persists raw FIRMS detections, interpreted GOES observations, weather inputs, predictions, and official cross-checks in structured tables. Signet monitors satellite heat detections for fire activity near your area.
🔗 Read more: https://signet.watch
